sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emily.
I am happy you are here.
Today, we will talk about Egypt.
Egypt is a famous country in North Africa.
Let's learn about it in simple English.
I will speak slowly.
You can listen and repeat if you want.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
Where is Egypt?
Egypt is in North Africa.
It is also part of the Middle East.
Egypt is next to the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea.
It is close to Libya, Sudan, and Israel.
A big part of Egypt is desert,
but there is also a green river valley.
What is the capital city of Egypt?
The capital city is Cairo.
Cairo is the largest city in Africa.
Many people live there.
Cairo is full of life, traffic, markets, and history.
Near Cairo, you can see the pyramids of Giza.
They are very old and very famous.
How many people live in Egypt?
About 110 million people live in Egypt.
That is a lot.
Most people live near the Nile River.
The Nile gives water to the land.
It is the longest river in the world.
What language do people speak in Egypt?
People speak Arabic.
Arabic is the official language.
The Egyptian Arabic dialect is a little different
from other Arabic dialects.
Many people also learn English in school.
In tourist areas, people speak basic English too.
What is the weather like in Egypt?
Egypt is a hot and dry country.
It does not rain very much.
The desert is dry and sunny.
In summer, it can be very hot,
especially in the south.
In winter, the weather is cooler and more comfortable.
The best time to visit Egypt is in autumn or spring.
What does Egypt look like?
Egypt has deserts, oases, mountains, and the Nile River.
Most of the land is dry and sandy.
But the Nile Valley is green and full of farms.
There are also beaches along the Red Sea.
People go there to swim and relax.
What is Egypt famous for?
Egypt is famous for its ancient history.
Thousands of years ago,
there were pharaohs, pyramids, and temples.
You can visit the pyramids of Giza,
the Sphinx, and the Valley of the Kings.
You can also see mummies and hieroglyphs in museums.
People all over the world learn about ancient Egypt in school.
What animals live in Egypt?
In the desert, you can see camels, lizards, and foxes.
Camels are strong and can live with little water.
Along the Nile, there are birds, frogs, and fish.
In the Red Sea, there are many colorful fish and coral reefs.
It is a great place for diving and snorkeling.
What do people eat in Egypt?
Egyptian food is delicious.
People eat bread, rice, beans, and vegetables.
One popular dish is koshari.
Koshari has rice, pasta, lentils, tomato sauce,
and crispy onions.
Another popular food is full medains,
mashed fava beans with oil and spices.
People also eat falafel, grilled meat, and shawarma.
For dessert, people eat baklava, rice pudding,
or sweet cakes.
They drink tea and sometimes strong coffee.
What is life like in Egypt?
Life in Egypt is busy in the cities
and quiet in the countryside.
People are friendly and love to talk.
Family is very important.
People often visit relatives and eat meals together.
There are many markets called souks,
where people buy food, clothes, and gifts.
People enjoy music, dancing, and celebrations.
One big celebration is Ramadan,
a special month for Muslims.
Some fun facts about Egypt.
The flag of Egypt is red, white, and black
with a golden eagle.
Egypt is home to one of the seven wonders
of the ancient world, the Great Pyramid of Giza.
The Suez Canal connects the Mediterranean Sea
and the Red Sea.
Egypt has more than 120 pyramids.
People have lived in Egypt for over 5,000 years.
Now you know many things about Egypt.
You know where it is, what the weather is like,
and what people speak.
You know about the Nile, the pyramids,
the food, and the people.
Great job.
I am Emily.
Goodbye.
